rules.description: Applicant must not be a UK national
rules.reason_if_failed: UK nationals do not require a visa to enter the UK

rules.description: Applicant must not be an Irish national
rules.reason_if_failed: Irish nationals do not require a visa to enter the UK

rules.description: Applicant must have a valid passport with at least 6 months validity
rules.reason_if_failed: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay

rules.description: Applicant must state a valid purpose for UK entry
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a valid reason for your UK visit

rules.description: Applicant must not be subject to a UK entry ban
rules.reason_if_failed: You are currently subject to a UK entry ban. You must appeal the ban before applying for a visa.

rules.description: Applicant must demonstrate sufficient funds for their stay
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide evidence of sufficient funds to support yourself during your UK stay

rules.description: Applicants from designated countries must provide a TB test certificate
rules.reason_if_failed: Based on your country of residence, you must provide a valid tuberculosis test certificate from an approved clinic

rules.description: Applicant must not have serious criminal convictions that would make them inadmissible
rules.reason_if_failed: You have criminal convictions that may make you inadmissible to the UK. Your application requires special consideration.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is seeking asylum in the UK
edge_cases.action: Route to asylum application process. Completely different procedures apply. Do not proceed with standard visa application.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is stateless with no recognized nationality
edge_cases.action: Route to specialist caseworker. Additional documentation and assessment required for stateless persons.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has had previous UK visa applications refused
edge_cases.action: Flag for enhanced scrutiny. Applicant must address reasons for previous refusal and provide additional evidence of changed circumstances.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is an unaccompanied minor under 18
edge_cases.action: Route to safeguarding team. Additional parental consent, welfare checks, and suitable arrangements in UK must be verified.

edge_cases.description: Application involves urgent humanitarian or compassionate circumstances
edge_cases.action: Fast-track to priority processing team. May bypass standard timelines. Requires supporting evidence of emergency.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's nationality or identity documents are disputed or unclear
edge_cases.action: Route to identity verification team. May require liaison with applicant's claimed country of origin. Application suspended until resolved.
